prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Nine of Swords. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual DQVI Milly: long blond hair, silver circlet, blue-violet tabard, silver chest piece and arm cuffs, mustard sash and cream trousers as official. Fully clothed in normal attire, she sits on a wooden bench at night with one hand against her forehead, reflecting on worries. Behind her exactly NINE steel swords hang on a stone wall in a very clear THREE BY THREE grid, nine complete blades and hilts separated. None touches her; no extra sword or weapon. Moonlit room opens to gentle mountains and hopeful dawn, nonviolent emotional concern, same crisp colored ink style. Ignore all reference page layout/text.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: Milly official blond hair, silver circlet and blue-violet/cream outfit retained; exactly nine wall swords arranged three-by-three, no blade touches her, no text/frame.
